now.title: Black Panther
now.text: N'Jobu is Shuri's uncle, killed by her father T'Chaka years before she is born. T'Challa later brings her to the Oakland building where it happened, which he turns into Wakanda's first outreach center.
now.on_a_card_about_b: N'Jobu's niece, born years after T'Chaka kills him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's uncle, killed by her father before she is born.

changes.evidence: A blood tie never met. N'Jobu is killed by T'Chaka in Oakland in spring 1992; Shuri is born in the late 1990s, as the stage text itself says ('years before she is born'). They never meet, not even in the ancestral plane (T'Challa sees T'Chaka, Erik sees N'Jobu). Shuri only hears of him and visits the building where he died. His own actions have no direct consequence for her; any effect on her runs through his son Erik, who keeps his own tie with Shuri.

owner_calls.question: J.A.R.V.I.S. and Edwin Jarvis never meet: the AIs only learn from Stark's old records that Tony modeled J.A.R.V.I.S. on Edwin, and in Vision's mind J.A.R.V.I.S. wears his face. Is being the human model for an AI a tie you want kept, or is this knowing ABOUT someone from records (drop)?
options: keep (Edwin is the inspiration behind J.A.R.V.I.S.)
drop (they never meet; knowing about from records)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's VisionQuest page: in the Mindspace, J.A.R.V.I.S.'s human avatar is a butler-like figure resembling Edwin Jarvis, who served as the inspiration for his creation. The stage text itself says the two never meet.
